verdicts.reason: A breaks the subhead as 'Every / mixed case.', which reads cleanly, and spaces the stack fairly evenly. However, the CTA sits far below the subhead, and the product/circle group ends up crowded against the footer text. B has the same structure, but its subhead wrap leaves 'case.' alone on the second line. The product is also pulled up against the CTA, leaving a large empty gap above the footer, so the vertical rhythm is lopsided. In both, the circle is just an arbitrary blob behind the can rather than a deliberate crop as in the original, and the button runs almost to the edges of the canvas.
